when.en: not (flag "georadiation_original_star" is set or flag "georadiation_signal_1_star" is set or flag "georadiation_signal_2_star" is set), and (owner = no or the owning empire: same value = root.controller), and there is a matching any system planet: owner = no, and not (planet class is "Toxic World" or planet class is "Gas Giant"), and not (flag "georadiation_original_planet" is set or flag "georadiation_signal_1_planet" is set or flag "georadiation_signal_2_planet" is set)
